ov: تاجوج فيلم تاريخي رومانسي سوداني من إخراج جاد الله جبارة سنة 1977. يعتبر أول فيلم روائي طويل عن السودان. يتناول قصة درامية عن الحب التعيس لاثنين من الخاطبين تجاه البطلة، تدور أحداثها في ريف شرق السودان، ويظهر فيها الممثل الشهير صلاح بن البادية. يعتبر ضمن أفضل الأفلام في السينما الأفريقية.
plotEn: The film's story takes place in the distant past in the eastern part of Sudan in an isolated village. Mohallak, a young tribal man, is deeply in love with his cousin Tajouje and openly confesses his love for her in a song. As this is considered shameful in his tribe, Tajouje's father refuses his marriage proposal. Some time later, Mohallak repents his mistake and the marriage is finally agreed upon. In the meantime, however, Ohag, another suitor, has shown his interest in Tajouje, which arouses Mohallak's jealousy. This develops into several dramatic complications that eventually result in tragedy: Mohallak has to leave his village as "a wandering bard of the deserts."
